arxiv-2008-00607.title: Quantum fluctuation of stress tensor in a higher-derivative scalar field theory around a cosmic string
arxiv-2008-00607.creator: Nahomi Kan, Masashi Kuniyasu, Kiyoshi Shiraishi
arxiv-2008-00607.description: Abstract In this paper, we calculate the vacuum fluctuation of the stress tensor of a higher-derivative theory around a thin cosmic string. To this end, we adopt the method to obtain the stress tensor from the effective action developed by Gibbons et al.

arxiv-2011-06922.title: Image Animation with Perturbed Masks
arxiv-2011-06922.creator: Yoav Shalev, Lior Wolf
arxiv-2011-06922.description: Abstract We present a novel approach for image-animation of a source image by a driving video, both depicting the same type of object. We do not assume the existence of pose models and our method is able to animate arbitrary objects without the knowledge of the object’s structure.

arxiv-2105-02322.title: Reconstructing shared dynamics with a deep neural network
arxiv-2105-02322.creator: Zsigmond Benkő, Zoltán Somogyvári
arxiv-2105-02322.description: Abstract Determining hidden shared patterns behind dynamic phenomena can be a gamechanger in multiple areas of research. Here we present the principles and show a method to identify hidden shared dynamics from time series by a two-module, feedforward neural network architecture: the Mapper-Coach network.

arxiv-2111-08965.title: RBI-ThPhys-2021-39
arxiv-2111-08965.creator: WUB/21-2
arxiv-2111-08965.description: Abstract We investigate wide-angle photoproduction of the η ′ \eta^{\prime} meson within the handbag approach to twist-3 accuracy. It turns out that, due to the gluon content of the η ′ \eta^{\prime} , this process is dominated by twist 2 in contrast with pion and η \eta photoproduction.

arxiv-2203-10261.title: FaiRR: Faithful and Robust Deductive Reasoning over Natural Language
arxiv-2203-10261.creator: Soumya Sanyal, Harman Singh, Xiang Ren
arxiv-2203-10261.description: Abstract Transformers have been shown to be able to perform deductive reasoning on a logical rulebase containing rules and statements written in natural language. Recent works show that such models can also produce the reasoning steps (i.e., the proof graph ) that emulate the model’s logical reasoning process.

arxiv-2301-03587.title: MACHINE LEARNING APPLIED TO PERUVIAN VEGETABLES IMPORTS
arxiv-2301-03587.creator: Ticona-Salluca Hugo, Torres-Cruz Fred, Tumi-Figueroa Ernesto Nayer
arxiv-2301-03587.description: Abstract The current research work is being developed as a training and evaluation object. the performance of a predictive model to apply it to the imports of vegetable products into Peru using artificial intelligence algorithms, specifying for this study the Machine Learning models: LSTM and PROPHET.

arxiv-2310-02285.title: QED based on an eight-dimensional spinorial wave equation of the electromagnetic field and the emergence of quantum gravity
arxiv-2310-02285.creator: Mikko Partanen, Jukka Tulkki
arxiv-2310-02285.description: Abstract Quantum electrodynamics (QED) is the most accurate of all experimentally verified physical theories. How QED and other theories of fundamental interactions couple to gravity through special unitary symmetries, on which the standard model of particle physics is based, is, however, still unknown.

arxiv-2502-16324.title: Deep Time Warping for Multiple Time Series Alignment
arxiv-2502-16324.creator: Alireza Nourbakhsh, Hoda Mohammadzade
arxiv-2502-16324.description: Abstract Time Series Alignment is a crucial task in signal processing with wide-ranging applications. Real-world signals often suffer from temporal shifts and scaling, leading to errors in raw data classification. This paper presents a novel Deep Learning-based approach for Multiple Time Series Alignment (MTSA).

arxiv-2505-00579.title: How to Use the IEEEtran L a T e X Templates
arxiv-2505-00579.creator: IEEE Publication Technology Department
arxiv-2505-00579.description: Abstract This document describes the most common article elements and how to use the IEEEtran class with L a T e X to produce files that are suitable for submission to the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE). IEEEtran can produce conference, journal and technical note (correspondence) papers with a suitable choice of class options.

plos-pone-0008113.creator: Jon Bohlin, Eystein Skjerve
plos-pone-0008113.description: PLOS ONE research article. DNA word frequencies, normalized for genomic AT content, are remarkably stable within prokaryotic genomes and are therefore said to reflect a “genomic signature.” The genomic signatures can be used to phylogenetically classify organisms from arbitrary sampled DNA. Genomic signatu

pmc-10575118.title: The Denoising Method for Transformer Partial Discharge Based on the Whale VMD Algorithm Combined with Adaptive Filtering and Wavelet Thresholding
pmc-10575118.creator: Zhongdong Wu, Zhuo Zhang, Li Zheng, Tianfeng Yan, Chunyang Tang, Pavlos Lazaridis
pmc-10575118.description: Partial discharge (PD) is the primary factor causing insulation degradation in transformers. However, the collected signals of partial discharge are often contaminated with significant noise. This makes it difficult to extract the PD signal and hinders subsequent signal analysis and processing.

pmc-10590986.title: Co-folding and RNA activation of poliovirus 3Cpro polyprotein precursors
pmc-10590986.creator: Grace Campagnola, Olve Peersen
pmc-10590986.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Positive-strand RNA viruses use long open reading frames to express large polyproteins that are processed into individual proteins by viral proteases. Polyprotein processing is highly regulated and yields intermediate species with different functions than the fully processed proteins, increasing the biochemical diversity of the compact viral genome while also presenting challenges in that proteins must remain stably folded in multiple contexts.

pmc-10647459.title: Exploring the Potential of the Corpus Callosum Area as a Predictive Marker for Impaired Information Processing in Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-10647459.creator: Shun Akaike, Tomoko Okamoto, Ryoji Kurosawa, Nozomi Onodera, Youwei Lin, Wakiro Sato, Takashi Yamamura, Yuji Takahashi
pmc-10647459.description: Early cognitive impairment (CI) detection is crucial in multiple sclerosis (MS). However, it can progress silently regardless of relapse activity and reach an advanced stage. We aimed to determine whether the corpus callosum area (CCA) is a sensitive and feasible marker for CI in MS compared to other neuroimaging markers.

pmc-10707513.title: Smoking and pre-existing co-morbidities as risk factors for developing severity of COVID-19 infection: Evidence from a field hospital in a rural area of Bangladesh
pmc-10707513.creator: Rashadul Islam, Sayem Ahmed, Samar Kishor Chakma, Tareq Mahmud, Abdullah Al Mamun, Ziaul Islam, M. Munirul Islam, Md. Feroz Kabir, Mosharop Hossian, Steve Zimmerman, Steve Zimmerman, Steve Zimmerman
pmc-10707513.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Since August 2020; the International Centre for Diarrhoeal Disease Research, Bangladesh (icddr,b) in collaboration with UNICEF has been operating a COVID-19 field hospital at the Teknaf sub-district of Cox’s Bazar in Bangladesh. This paper is focused on estimating the effects of a history of tobacco smoking and pre-existing co-morbidities on the severity of COVID-19 infection among adult patients admitted into the aforesaid hospital. We conducted a retrospective data analysis of COVID-19 adult patients hospitalized from August 27, 2020 to April 20, 2022.

pmc-11489223.title: Protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor type 2 (PTPN2) gene polymorphisms (rs2542151, rs7234029) in Egyptian Behçet’s disease patients: a preliminary report
pmc-11489223.creator: Doaa H. S. Attia, Marwa Alkaffas, Mervat Eissa, Laila Rashed, Rasha A. M. Khattab, Radwa Elzanaty, Rabab A. Khattab, Lamees A. Samy
pmc-11489223.description: Single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) of the protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor type 2 (PTPN2) gene have been documented to be linked with several autoimmune disorders including Behçet’s disease (BD). PTPN2 SNPs rs2542151 and rs7234029 have been assessed using real-time PCR in 96 BD patients and 50 controls matched by age and gender.

pmc-12391372.title: OLED illuminated metasurfaces for holographic image projection
pmc-12391372.creator: Junyi Gong, Mohammad Biabanifard, Kou Yoshida, Graham A. Turnbull, Andrea Di Falco, Ifor D. W. Samuel
pmc-12391372.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) are thin film optoelectronic devices that feature simple fabrication, light weight and broad tunability, which makes them widely used in mobile phone and TV displays. As a flat and surface-emitting light source, OLEDs are also used in emerging applications such as optical wireless communications, biophotonics and sensing, where the ability to integrate with other technologies makes them good candidates to realise miniaturised photonic platforms.

pmc-13220172.title: Potential roles of plant metabolites and Traditional Chinese Medicine formulas in regulating glycolysis-OXPHOS plasticity in gastric precancerous lesions and gastric cancer: a critical appraisal of the evidence
pmc-13220172.creator: Shenghao Li, Jiao Ma, Cuicui Ma, Yanru Song, Liang Chang, Bingjie Huo
pmc-13220172.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The Warburg effect in tumor cells is characterized by increased glucose uptake, enhanced glycolytic flux, and the conversion of pyruvate to lactate for energy generation, rather than its utilization in oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS), even under aerobic conditions. This metabolic reprogramming, coupled with OXPHOS dysfunction, is closely correlated with the initiation, invasion, metastasis, chemoresistance, and poor prognosis of gastric precancerous lesions (GPL) and gastric cancer (GC).

pmc-13306034.title: Analysis of Food Insecurity in U.S. Colleges Using Current Assessment Tools—A Systematic Review
pmc-13306034.creator: Qi Fu, Maggie Cappiello, Elizabeth M. Gardner

pmc-13347932.title: When network biology meets human genetics
pmc-13347932.creator: Sai Zhang
pmc-13347932.description: Rare variant association analyses are typically performed at the single-gene level, overlooking the molecular interactions that organize cellular systems. In this issue, Nazeen et al. introduce NERINE, a probabilistic rare variant burden test that integrates gene and protein networks to improve statistical power and biological interpretability.

uslaw-usc-t21-s467f.description: United States Code, Title 21 (Food And Drugs); Chapter 10 (Poultry And Poultry Products Inspection). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Exemptions; authorities under food, drug, and cosmetic provisions unaffected Poultry and poultry products shall be exempt from the provisions of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act [21 U.S.C. 301 et seq.] to the extent of the application or extension thereto.
